title: azt hiszem: I Think, I Believe

sections.title: Believing, not just opining
sections.content: azt hiszem ("I think, I believe") is built from hisz ("to believe") in its definite form hiszem, plus azt, the accusative of az ("that") pointing forward to the idea that follows. Unlike an English "I believe that...", no hogy is needed — the clause just follows directly after a comma. You've already heard Károly and others say it in earlier lessons; now you know exactly how it's built.

items.spanish: Azt hiszem, ez a jobb megoldás.
items.english: I think this is the better solution.

sections.content: azt hiszem itself drops hogy, but a question built around it — Azt hiszed, hogy...? — can still use hogy, because now hiszed is the main verb of a real question, not just an opinion-opener sitting in front of a statement.
